testFuzz_deposit_fromCustomGasTokenChain.notice: Tests that the deposit function reverts when called on a custom gas token chain.

testFuzz_deposit_fromNonCustomGasTokenCh.notice: Tests that the deposit function can be called on a non-custom gas token chain.

testFuzz_relayERC20_fromMessengerCustomG.notice: Tests that the relayERC20 function can be called from the         L2ToL2CrossDomainMessenger as long as the crossDomainMessageSender is the         SuperchainWETH contract, even when the chain is a custom gas token chain. Shows         that ETH is not minted in this case but the SuperchainWETH balance is updated.

testFuzz_relayERC20_fromMessengerNotFrom.notice: Tests that the relayERC20 function reverts when called from the         L2ToL2CrossDomainMessenger but the crossDomainMessageSender is not the         SuperchainWETH contract.

testFuzz_relayERC20_fromMessenger_succee.notice: Tests that the relayERC20 function can be called from the         L2ToL2CrossDomainMessenger as long as the crossDomainMessageSender is the         SuperchainWETH contract.

testFuzz_relayERC20_notFromMessenger_fai.notice: Tests that the relayERC20 function reverts when not called from the         L2ToL2CrossDomainMessenger.

testFuzz_sendERC20_insufficientBalance_f.notice: Tests that the sendERC20 function reverts when called with insufficient balance.

testFuzz_sendERC20_sufficientBalance_suc.notice: Tests that the sendERC20 function always succeeds when called with a sufficient         balance no matter the sender, amount, recipient, or chain ID.

testFuzz_sendERC20_sufficientFromCustomG.notice: Tests that the sendERC20 function can be called with a sufficient balance on a         custom gas token chain. Also tests that the proper calls are made and the proper         events are emitted but ETH is not burned via the ETHLiquidity contract.
